2026-10-28 16:42:56.355759 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-10-28 16:42:56.355762 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,

2026-10-28 16:42:56.355768 | controller | • In case of template units, the unit is meant to be enabled with some
